title.narrative: Food Resilience System: Construction of Silos and Irrigation Systems in Sierra Leone

description.narrative: The project aims to increase preparedness against food insecurity and improve the resilience of the food system in Sierra Leone. UNOPS leads on the development of an irrigation system for 100 hectares of land across 20 sites for vegetable farming, as well as, the construction of four integrated corrugated steel silos for rice storage in one district.
